name: Unassuming Laborer

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Nobody pays attention to the gardener keeping the hedges, the maid serving the food, or the dirt-covered worker eating in the corner of a tavern. You have mastered the ability to be an unassuming presence wherever you are. When you Impersonate a laborer, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception checks and DC to avoid others detecting your deception, it only takes you 1 minute to assemble the disguise, and you don't need a disguise kit to do so. You can't use this feat's benefits to Impersonate a specific individual.
